# Webotee — Amazon Product Research MCP

> Webotee AI Connect is a hosted MCP (Model Context Protocol) connector that adds
> Webotee's Amazon brand, seller, niche and buy-box research dataset to your own
> Claude or ChatGPT. It is a research connector for Amazon sellers — it reads and
> explains pre-collected marketplace intelligence; it does not place orders or
> change Amazon listings, and it is not a live shopping agent.

- Product / start a 7-day free trial: https://www.webotee.com/amazon-product-research-mcp
- Connector URL (Streamable HTTP, OAuth): https://app.webotee.com/mcp
- Pricing: https://www.webotee.com/pricing (Starter $29 / Scout $89 / Scout Pro $179 / Scout + Protect $295)
- Requires a paid Webotee plan (Starter or higher).

## Docs
- Setup (Claude, ChatGPT, Cursor, VS Code, Claude Code): /docs/setup.md
- Authentication (OAuth 2.1): /docs/auth.md
- Tool catalog (50+ tools): /docs/tools.md
- Example prompts: /examples/prompts.md
- Python quickstart: /examples/quickstart.py

## What you can ask
Which sellers dominate the buy box on a brand; find under-competed brands and
under-served niches to source; reverse a seller into the brands they carry by
estimated sales; map the operator network behind a listing; score an ASIN for
FBA sourcing; detect a brand under attack; flag unauthorized sellers and MAP
violations; compare Amazon vs Walmart pricing.
